notablePrerequisites: You control lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{G}.
description:
Cast Cloud of Faeries without paying its mana cost.
Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, untapping two lands that can produce {1}{G}.
Activate those two lands by tapping those, adding {1}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Cloud of Faeries to your hand and giving Temur Sabertooth indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat.
